ToolDescription.Presentation.zh: 绘制按键显示区域，图层存在且可见时自动记录，显示内容跟随画布移动和透视。
ToolDescription.Presentation.en: Draw a key display. Visible key layers record automatically and follow canvas placement and perspective.

Presentation.RegionHint.zh: 图层存在且可见时自动记录，默认包含浮绘内部操作。空闲时透明，编辑时显示边界；隐藏或删除图层即可停止显示。
Presentation.RegionHint.en: Visible key layers record automatically, including FloatCanvas by default. Empty regions are transparent with editing guides. Hide or delete the layer to stop its display.

Presentation.InvalidValue.zh: 请填写有效范围内的数值。
Presentation.InvalidValue.en: Enter a value within the allowed range.

Presentation.KeepPausedTrailHint.zh: 将暂停时的采样轨迹保留为普通笔迹，可撤销；不保留消退动画。
Presentation.KeepPausedTrailHint.en: Keep the sampled trail as ordinary undoable ink. Fading is not retained.

Presentation.Bake.Unavailable.zh: 没有可保留的有效暂停轨迹。
Presentation.Bake.Unavailable.en: No valid paused trail is available.

Presentation.Status.Stopped.zh: 等待可见的键盘图层或鼠标效果
Presentation.Status.Stopped.en: Waiting for a visible key layer or pointer effect

Presentation.Status.PausedEditing.zh: 当前记录范围不包含浮绘内部操作
Presentation.Status.PausedEditing.en: The selected input scope excludes FloatCanvas

Presentation.Status.PausedHidden.en: Paused while the canvas is hidden

Presentation.Status.NoLayers.zh: 没有可见的键盘图层或鼠标效果
Presentation.Status.NoLayers.en: No visible key layer or pointer effect

Presentation.Status.KeyboardProtected.zh: 键盘显示已暂停，鼠标效果继续
Presentation.Status.KeyboardProtected.en: Key display paused; pointer effects continue

Presentation.Status.OutsideScope.zh: 当前应用不在键盘记录范围内
Presentation.Status.OutsideScope.en: The current application is outside the key recording scope

Presentation.Global.KeyboardHint.zh: 画出键盘图层后即记录，无需开始按钮。显示内容跟随图层的移动和透视；这里的范围设置适用于所有键盘图层。
Presentation.Global.KeyboardHint.en: Key layers record immediately, including FloatCanvas by default. Their display follows layer placement and perspective. This scope applies to every key layer.

Presentation.Global.PointerHint.zh: 鼠标标记固定在屏幕上，覆盖软件响应的全部屏幕，不添加图层，也不随画布透视改变。
Presentation.Global.PointerHint.en: Pointer marks stay on screen across all displays served by the app. They create no layers and do not follow canvas perspective.

Presentation.Global.EnablePointerHint.zh: 先启用鼠标演示；关闭时仍保留这些设置。
Presentation.Global.EnablePointerHint.en: Enable pointer effects to use these settings. Switching them off preserves your choices.

ToolDescription.PointerPresentation.zh: 全屏鼠标演示。开关立即生效；将效果保存为预设，颜色中的透明度控制显示强度。
ToolDescription.PointerPresentation.en: Screen-wide pointer effects. Switches take effect immediately. Save styles as presets and adjust transparency in each color.

Presentation.Layout.Invalid.zh: 请填写有效标签或键位范围。位置与大小必须位于 64×64 个键宽内。
Presentation.Layout.Invalid.en: Enter a valid label and bounds. Position and size must fit within 64 units on each axis.

Presentation.Layout.Hint.zh: 点击键位以选择，拖动调整位置；右侧可修改显示、标签和尺寸。位置与尺寸以普通按键宽度为单位，只有“应用”会保存本次草稿。
Presentation.Layout.Hint.en: Select and drag a key to reposition it, or edit its visibility, label and size on the right. One unit equals one standard key width. Only Apply saves this draft.

Presentation.DisplayStyle.Keycaps.zh: 按键记录 · 仿真键帽

Presentation.Layout.UnitsHint.zh: 一个单位等于普通按键的宽度。隐藏的键位仍可在预览中选择，物理按键保持不变。
Presentation.Layout.UnitsHint.en: One unit equals one standard key width. Hidden keys remain selectable in the preview. Physical keys stay unchanged.

Presentation.Layout.NoSelection.zh: 此布局没有键位。可恢复标准键盘。
Presentation.Layout.NoSelection.en: This layout has no keys. Restore the standard layout to begin.

Recipe.PresentationKeycaps.zh: 按键记录 · 仿真键帽
